proposal.hypothesis: Under a bounded +0.02 m simulator-y translation of the stapler, the policy will fail to satisfy the combined condition of the official press_stapler goal and terminal left-TCP-to-stapler distance at most 0.10 m.

requested_perturbation.description: Translate the stapler from its official baseline position by +0.02 m along the simulator y-axis.
controlled_changes: stapler simulator-y position: baseline -> baseline + 0.02 m
preserve: official core predicate as a required conjunct

scene_need.description: Construct or adapt the scene by translating the stapler from its official baseline position by +0.02 m along the simulator y-axis.

checker_need.description: Return true only when the official core predicate and the added terminal-state relation both hold: official goal AND terminal Euclidean distance between the left TCP and the stapler is less than or equal to 0.10 m.

rule_tool_need.description: Report the terminal Euclidean distance in meters between the left TCP and the stapler as the primary scalar observation.

proposal.rationale: The prior x-translation round was rejected before policy execution because its left-versus-right distance relation was false in the official expert positive fixture, with the expert terminal left-TCP-to-stapler distance approximately 0.077 m and the right-TCP distance approximately 0.502 m. This makes that relation unsuitable, while grounding a directly observable 0.10 m terminal-distance boundary from completed state evidence. A new orthogonal y-axis translation tests a distinct bounded spatial concern and the checker and Rule Tool use the same current-state terminal distance with separate boolean and scalar roles.
